acceptance: The multi-warehouse NULL test runs on Dask and Modin where installed and reports a skip, not a pass, where a backend is absent.
Any backend that returns a different answer is fixed in the helper, not special-cased by platform name.
description:
Gap. PR #4169 fixed NULL handling in the pandas-family helpers for TPC-DS Q16, Q94 and Q95 (`_multi_warehouse_orders_pandas`, and the non-NULL row filter in Q94). The new test `tests/unit/core/tpcds/test_multi_warehouse_orders.py` runs pandas only; existing Dask unit tests pass. Modin and cuDF share the helper through `ctx.groupby_agg` and were not exercised. The helper relies on `min`/`max` skipping NULL and on `NaN != NaN` being true, guarded by `notnull()`; those are the points where another backend could differ.

Expected: either the test is parametrised over every pandas-family adapter importable in the test environment (skipping cleanly when absent), or user documentation states which backends the NULL behaviour is verified on.

Guardrails: no GPU or cloud dependency in the unit tier; cuDF may stay skip-only locally.
